messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Datadog metrics & traces ingestion lag detected in us-east-1 — median delay ~6m, some streams up to ~12m. Severity P2. Status: investigating. https://status.datadoghq.com/incident/xxxx

alex park: oncall here, acked. starting triage. first steps: verify customer impact, check if any alerting fired, look for recent infra changes.

maria gonzalez: dashboards show ceiling at ~12:03 UTC for many host metrics. logs still flow from our logging pipeline, but APM spans are sparse.

tim chen: I can confirm traces are thin. No recent deploys on infra in last 90m. likely downstream ingestion delay.

sara li: support ops reports increased "missing metrics" tickets. none are reporting product errors yet, mostly visibility complaints.

alex park: customer-facing impact: product functional, but our internal alerting may be delayed/suppressed bc many alerts route through Datadog. I'll toggle CloudWatch fallback for critical health alerts.

alex park: ```
# toggle cw fallback for critical checks
./infra/runbooks/fallbacks/toggle_cw_fallback.sh --service=redwood-api --level=critical
```

incident-bot: runbook action started by alex park: toggle_cw_fallback (step 1/3). ETA ~3m.

maria gonzalez: spun up a temporary ingest-proxy metric emitter to send synthetic health metrics to our internal Grafana and to CW so ops can still see vital signals. Posting panel snapshots.

tim chen: created a ephemeral Grafana dashboard that points at the proxy and CW. linked in channel.

support-ops: CS notified 4 customers about potential telemetry gaps. One customer escalated due to APM visibility for payments.

sara li: suggested status blurb: "We are experiencing delayed metric and trace ingestion from Datadog affecting visibility across some dashboards. User-facing services continue to operate. Engineers have enabled fallbacks to CloudWatch and an ingest proxy. Updates every 15 minutes." ok to post?

alex park: yes, please add: "If you rely on Datadog alerts for autoscaling, expect delayed triggers; we've enabled guardrails to prevent unintended scale-downs."

support-ops: posted to status.redwood.com and messaged customers via support. pinned runbook link in channel.

maria gonzalez: capturing artifacts for postmortem: proxy logs, timestamps of ingestion gaps per service, and which alert groups were suppressed. please annotate if you enabled any manual thresholds.

alex park: timeline + customer-impact table in progress. current state: Mitigating via CW & proxy; oncall holding. If ingestion lag persists >30m we'll do an explicit handoff to eng-oncall for continuous monitoring.

incident-bot: Datadog status updated: "Investigating an issue affecting metrics ingestion in us-east-1" — 1840501256

eng-oncall: I can take over at +30m if needed. pre-authorize any infra scaling or temporary alert remapping.

tim chen: quick note: make sure we patch any replay/backfill steps for pre-warmed caches so we don't double-count metrics when they come back.

sara li: also add a quick public note in the status update about expected next update time and contact channel for urgent customer escalations.

alex park: agreed. next heartbeat update scheduled for 1840501410. Current action items: 1) keep CW fallback enabled for critical alerts 2) monitor ingest-proxy and Grafana panels 3) collect gap windows for PM.

support-ops: CS will keep alerting affected customers every 15m. will escalate immediately on any functional regressions.

incident-bot: Incident state -> Mitigating (partial). Datadog: "Partial mitigation underway." — 1840501499

alex park: traces still degraded but critical alerts on CW are healthy. continuing to monitor for 30m then decide on handoff. compiling notes for post-incident.

maria gonzalez: added sample graph images for the proxy and CW into the shared doc.

eng-oncall: standing by for handoff. if you hand over please include: runbook steps executed, scripts used, list of suppressed alert groups, and customer list notified.

sara li: thanks team. small ask for postmortem: capture decision points and why we chose CW + proxy vs pushing to a different vendor endpoint.

alex park: noted. final for now: continuing monitoring; next update at 1840501610 or sooner if situation changes.
